seedMeta.title: TCG Production Management Transition
seedMeta.assumptions: All projects have a hypothetical November 16, 2026 start. Time estimates cover hands-on managerial planning/coordination, not all employee labour. Dates and owners are tentative and fully editable.

projects.name: Team feedback & morale
projects.description: Team-first announcement, prepared one-on-ones, anonymous themes and visible quick wins.

projects.name: Leadership responsibilities & decisions
projects.description: Clarify the proposed role split, approvals and escalation paths before large changes.

projects.name: Department process maps & SOP handoffs
projects.description: Walk through the actual process, map handoffs and prioritize SOP/work-centre updates.

projects.name: Pegboard workstation pilot
projects.description: Trial two workstations before committing to broader pegboard and Kanban rollout.

projects.name: TCGA3 notices & communication rollout
projects.description: Standard Toyota A3-style notices, staff acknowledgment and searchable Odoo register.

projects.name: Lean floor layout & shop reset
projects.description: Allow about two weeks to plan and verify the layout before a separately approved Saturday move.

projects.name: Workstation scheduling & skills coverage
projects.description: People-to-station roster, qualified backups, cross-training and realistic coverage.

projects.name: Odoo manufacturing & machine traveler
projects.description: Make module builds, refurb and serial-traceable QC records work end-to-end before cutover.

projects.name: Quality, CSA & evidence readiness
projects.description: Clarify ownership and build complete traceable evidence across departments.

projects.name: Weekly KPI review & owner reporting
projects.description: Create a repeatable report that protects output, flags blockers and documents decisions.

projects.name: Production capacity & handoff protection
projects.description: Keep actual build output realistic while leadership time, pre-testing and coverage change.

projects.name: Onboarding, training & cross-coverage
projects.description: Simple orientation plus practical station qualification and coverage records.

projects.name: Version 2 readiness & R&D handoffs
projects.description: Production/R&D change control, field feedback and readiness before Version 2 cut-in.
